fx.title: Spatial effects
fx.subtitle: Reverb and concert hall
fx.reverbDescription: Light Schroeder-style reverb: short pre-delay, four comb filters, and two all-pass filters for depth without muddying the cabin.
fx.concertHallDescription: Larger hall inspired by concert rooms: moderate pre-delay, stable tail, high-frequency damping, and limited wet mixing.
fx.description: Concert Hall uses a real-time algorithmic hall. It is not a replacement for real IR convolution plus vehicle MIMO correction, but it keeps clarity with controlled dry/wet mixing.

howToUse.title: How to use EpicenterDSP Lite
howToUse.intro: EpicenterDSP Lite v1.0.0 is a local music player with basic Epicenter processing, safe EQ presets, and a 30-song imported library.
howToUse.libraryBody: Use the main library screen to import up to 30 files. Duplicates do not consume a slot, and deleting a song frees one.
howToUse.playerBody: Select any song to play, or use the Play and Shuffle buttons in Songs, Artists, or Playlists.
howToUse.queueBody: Add tracks to the queue, play next, or reorder items for the exact listening flow you want.
howToUse.eqBody: Open the EQ tab and choose one of six safe presets. Manual 31-band tuning and Auto EQ are available in Full.
howToUse.dspBody: Enable Epicenter DSP and choose Normal for cars, subwoofers, or larger systems; choose Headphones for headphones and portable speakers. Lite includes Intensity in both modes and Sweep in Normal.
howToUse.playlistsBody: Create playlists in the Playlists tab, then play in order or shuffle instantly.
howToUse.tipsBody: Hi-Res tracks are marked automatically. You can switch languages and crossfade settings in Settings.

onboarding.title: Quick Start
onboarding.step1Description: Import audio files from Files to get started.
onboarding.step2Description: Choose a safe EQ preset and use the basic Epicenter processor to shape your bass and clarity.
onboarding.step3Description: Create playlists, build your queue, and enjoy background playback.

tutorial.welcomeBody: In four quick steps you will learn how to enable Epicenter and choose the right engine for your system.
tutorial.enableBody: Open the Epicenter tab and turn on its switch. This is the heart of the bass effect.
tutorial.normalBody: Use it in a car, with a subwoofer, or on larger systems. Lite lets you tune Sweep and Intensity; Full adds advanced Width and Balance.
tutorial.headphonesBody: Use it with headphones and portable speakers. It is a different engine for small drivers: here you only need to adjust Intensity.
tutorial.readyBody: Raise or lower Intensity for more or less bass. Switch between Normal and Headphones whenever you change listening systems.
